description.value: Fatburger on Davie Street is a casual burger restaurant in Vancouver's West End, serving fresh-never-frozen Alberta Angus beef burgers cooked to order, alongside chicken wings, hand-scooped milkshakes, and veggie options. The Canadian franchise has been operating since 2005 and is part of a chain founded in Los Angeles in 1952. It offers dine-in and takeout in a lively neighbourhood corridor popular with pedestrians and cyclists.
